description: End-to-end test suite for verifying language translations and HTML attributes in a web application using Playwright.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the test suite to run in serial mode.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test group for a specific language translation scenario.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Sets the context or configuration for subsequent tests, such as locale.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for verifying translations and HTML attributes.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the page to reach a specific load state.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Finds elements on the page based on selectors.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertions for verifying element visibility, text content, and count.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates a click on an element.
